fusions.name: Puddle Slap
fusions.desc: Slaps water over every enemy within 2 tiles for 3 damage, with a 50% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipped Stone
fusions.desc: Skips a flat stone into the target for 10 damage and stuns it for 0.8 seconds; it then leaps to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of that.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it instead.

fusions.name: Unruffled
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 50%, every heal reaching you is worth 30% more for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
